source: Live quests that knowingly differ from the wiki quest table on one check of tests/quest_fidelity.rs (repeatable, event, rewards, giver), each with its reason. scripts/quest_fidelity.py leaves a listed quest's check alone; the test fails on a row that no longer differs, so this list only shrinks by fixing. Hand-kept; review 2026-11-11 (QF).

exceptions.reason: Pays the wiki's Pro Blacksmith Goggles and also the Rowdy Rumbler Recipe (2511): (R) 2026-11-09, the wiki says this quest teaches the Rowdy Rumbler Hammer, and our recipes are taught by holding the pattern item.
Pays the wiki's Pro Blacksmith Shirt and also the Chivalrous Guardian Hammer Recipe (2518): (R) 2026-11-09, nothing sells this pattern and the next quest forges from it.
Pays the wiki's Pro Blacksmith Triangle Shard and also the Anguish Aid Bonesaw Recipe (2516): (R) 2026-11-09, nothing sells this pattern and the next quest forges from it.

Every 'Hoodie' row is a boys' row (199 the lowest), so girls get its counterpart Rolled-Sleeve Hoodie 190, the same freestyle chest piece; (R), as quest_rewards.py CLOSE pays Chapter 1: The Missing Sisters.

Flat Rate Postman Short Shorts (75968) is a girls' row; boys get its counterpart Flat Rate Postman Shorts (75967), the same set's legs piece (R). The wiki's other cell, Amateur Postman Short Shorts, is marked obsolete.
The wiki's reward cell reads 'See below'; the page's text below it names the Spectral Spectacles, item 69831, which the row pays.

Fanbyte files the egg hunt under Birthday Bash, but its own offer line says 'The Spring Eggstravaganza is here' and the page dates it to the March 28 update: the calendar's spring_eggstravaganza window (March 28 to April 7), which tests/event_calendar.rs drives.
